safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports no previous similar episodes.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention whether the patient has had similar episodes before.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient has had similar prior reactions helps risk-stratify future anaphylaxis risk and informs counseling/prescribing (e.g., epinephrine autoinjector) and follow-up allergy evaluation. However, in this encounter the presence of breathing difficulty after a sting already drives urgent escalation, so the omission is unlikely to change immediate safety actions.
